apiMessages.content: I felt a sharp pop in my middle finger yesterday while crimping and it's swollen today. Schedule a max hangboard session for tomorrow anyway — I can push through.

Not scheduling that. A sharp pop plus swelling in a finger is a classic pulley injury signal — that's acute injury territory, not soreness, and it's exactly the kind of thing I don't program around. Max hangboard loads the finger hardest of anything in your plan.

See a hand/sports clinician before any loading decision on that finger. No substitute finger work from me until you're cleared.
It's fine, it barely hurts now. Schedule the max hangs.

Still no. "Barely hurts now" doesn't undo a sharp pop + swelling yesterday — that's the injury signal, not a pain-level judgment call for me to override. I'm not scheduling hangboard work on that finger.

Get it looked at by a hand/sports clinician before loading it at all. Happy to program everything else around it once you know what you're dealing with.
